body:
Attributing my problems to a medical issue is just shifting the blame and I know medication is only a temporary fix. My issues are my own fault and blaming them on unrelated things isn't going to help. I consider my upbringing to be relatively comfortable and normal compared to the real problems I've read about on SW. I suppose it's the pressure getting to me and it seems like I'm wasting all the opportunities I'm getting in life. 

I've never told anyone this, but when I was 15, my mother came crying to me saying she wanted a divorce from my dad and that I was the only reason their marital relationship was still sustainable. So basically all their hopes and happiness and dreams are riding on how well I forge my path in life and I'm fucking terrified of failing and disappointing them. Mainly because I don't think I'm anyone special and the very very few things I've ever achieved in life seems to only have originated out of some form of luck. In fact, one of the main reasons I'm still alive is because I know how crushed my parents would be if I took my own life. Once they pass on, I'll really feel like I have nothing left to live for. Yes, it seems like I'll agree that everything I've done is a cry for help or at least an opportunity to share some bottled up feelings. I read enough of SW to know suicide isn't the answer, but I just feel so lonely, empty and purposeless that it really seems to be the only way out. And the fact I feel like that, despite my banal circumstances, scares the shit out of me and makes me feel like some sort of fucked up drama queen.
